japan_1898_register_legal_status.locator: Table 3, printed pp. 338–339, national total row. Table 1, printed p. 335, for the all-status population control
japan_1898_register_legal_status.eligible_universe: Table 3 crosses official legal status with sex and position on the family register (head or other family member). The denominator is 43,758,415 registered persons. The table excludes abandoned children and unregistered people in confinement. Kazoku denotes the peerage, shizoku the former warrior estate and heimin commoners. These categories report legal status. They give no occupation, income or worker counts. Sex totals within each status are the sums of the printed head and family columns.
